releases.name: Release v0.65.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(cli): enforce read-only workspace settings in untrusted folders by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29583
* fix(core): avoid duplicate tool response turns when resuming sessions by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29618
* fix(core): prevent deletion of resumed session history on quick exit (#29198) by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29584
* Changelog for v0.64.0-preview.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29656
* Changelog for v0.63.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29659
* fix(core): align OAuth callback iss parameter validation with RFC 9207 metadata by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29616
* fix(cli): prevent unnecessary terminal clears and scroll resets when expanding with Ctrl+O by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29640
* chore(release): bump version to 0.65.0-nightly.20261006.gfb972b2f8 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29657
* fix(ci): add missing loop in unassign-inactive-assignees workflow by @ugorla-dev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29609
* fix(core): enforce terminal user turn invariant and normalize request contents by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29612
* `feat(telemetry): support custom OTLP headers in telemetry configuration` by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29641
* fix(auth): prevent infinite verification and OAuth retry loops by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29655
* fix(cli): handle JSON parse and response stream errors in fetchJson by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29658
* fix(core): preserve line terminators in truncateString by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29673
* fix(vscode-ide-companion): make IdeServer.stop() resolve while MCP sessions are open by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29674
* fix(core): retain ask_user question text in the tool result display by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29677
* fix(core): eliminate false positives on untrusted command flags and compound loops by @DavidAPierce in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29672
* fix(cli): clear cached credentials when re-selecting Google login by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29643
* fix(cli): resolve hang on Enter keypress in interactive mode (#23297) by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29476
* perf(core): optimize ignore filtering and enable subtree pruning (#29077) by @amelidev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29582
* fix(a2a-server): isolate tool rejection to active call in sequential batches by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29683
* fix(cli): skip eager recursive file reading for @<directory> references by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29617
* fix(cli): keep loading other extensions when one fails the allowlist check by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29720
* fix(cli): correct reverse search highlight index for expanding unicode characters by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29699
* fix(core): treat whitespace-only UTF-16 and UTF-32 files as empty by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29722
* fix(cli): restore debounced static UI refresh on terminal width changes by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29644
* fix(cli): prevent session poisoning on rapid Ctrl-C interruption by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29728


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/compare/v0.64.0...v0.65.0
